title: The Safe Volcano Team
question: 把今天“观察危险现象 -> 保持安全距离 -> 设法收集证据 -> 说明目的”的表达，放进 school science team 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: We observed an active volcano model in the science room. We could not go closer because the teacher wanted everyone to keep a safe distance. We managed to take clear photographs and measure temperatures from a safe place. We used a remote camera so that we could observe safely. When the model became too hot, we moved back just in time.
word_bank: so that we could observe safely
